positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
C++11/14/17/20, Lua, PHP, Python, Ruby
Working on the backend reporting engine that handles all the requests for data from Adobe Analytics.  Develop new features for Analytics.
Triage and resolve customer reported issues. 
Head up live environment troubleshooting.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
C++, Javascript, Lua, XBox One, X360, PC
Creation of new games. Porting of previous games to new platforms. Updates to currently active games. Published game on XBO shortly after launch. Fast prototyping of game ideas before full implementation. Server/client messaging for mobile game. 
Notable games: Disney Infinity (PS3,X360,PC), NHL Supercard (Android/iOS mobile), A World of Keflings (PC, X360, WiiU)

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Worked in Ruby/Rails to write critical reports, stats and alert/monitoring applications for real time black box trading system. Create stream parsing that handles large volumes of incoming data. Implement parsers, crawlers, stats, reports for data mining. Assist other members of the company in adding features to our customer relations system/database.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: I worked as a programmer for the Nintendo DS platform. Responsibilities included working on a team with other programmers and assist them with bugs, hardware intricacies, and occasionally programming concepts. Handle a lot of low level memory management / layout. I did a lot of gameplay programming, UI programming, and if needed Tools creation for design/art/other programmers. Work heavily with artists for programming gameplay UI.

positions.title: NNCSS
positions.description: I was part of the IPSec team for Nortel Networks.  Provided assistance to companies with small office to large corporate networks that used VPN devices. Tasks included troubleshooting for VPN and related traffic for the Contivity line of products.  Included troubleshooting for the VPN device and related equipment for encryption, authentication, QoS, routing, backup/failover, upgrades(software and hardware), as well as initial setup for the VPN devices and devices attached to them.

positions.title: Technical Support Rep
positions.description: I worked at the Redstorm facility taking calls for all of Ubisoft’s titles (300+ games).  Technical support in this area dealt a large amount in system requirements and the various intricacies of video cards and their capabilities. Also dealt with significant portions of software conflicts, and other things that would stop a program from installing/running. Also included nominal amounts of network troubleshooting.
